scope.workload: unpaired 60 s real Behavior and Tracking-role camera recordings plus four-output Visual Stimulus recording
scope.observed_run_external_decode: not run; parent requested no decode/test during sequential recording work

comparison_caveat: The observed run loaded sitecustomize queue instrumentation; the baseline run did not. Instrumentation overhead and run-to-run variance are confounded. Observed Visual Stimulus capacity drops increased from 2342 baseline to 3312; do not attribute that change to production behavior or call the runs method-equivalent.

margin_calculations.rule: ceil(1.2 * measured high-water occupancy), in the owning capacity units; a measured maximum at a hard cap is censored and is only a lower bound on demand

camera_recording_queue_frames.recommendation: 12 frames as a temporary candidate for the shared camera recording_queue_frames field; repeat under equivalent instrumented workload and confirm zero drops before acceptance

camera_pending_records_capacity.recommendation: retain 10000; observed usage is far below the current bound

visual_stimulus_capture_slots.recommendation: 4 slots as a temporary candidate; repeat a matched run and establish memory/latency impact before acceptance

camera_encoder_stall_timeout.recommendation: retain 10000 ms; observed isolated consumer service maxima do not justify changing the failure timeout

camera_post_cutoff_drain_margin.limitation: The recorded terminal drain observation includes the configured margin; it cannot isolate camera delivery demand or establish a worst-case bound. Keep the accepted 125 ms value pending the A10 full-load/Eye verification.

file_closure.limitation: These are instrumented queue/input closure components, not end-to-end encoder finalization, file sync, frame-log close, controller Finished delivery, or complete output closure. Baseline end-to-end cutoff-to-session-ended was 321.2069 ms; no matched observed end-to-end closure metric was derived here.

recommendations_and_limits: Treat camera recording_queue_frames=12 and Visual Stimulus capture_slots=4 only as measured temporary candidates, not accepted configuration or zero-loss proof.
The tracking camera queue reached its 10-frame pixel cap and dropped 3 frames; the observed maximum is censored, so 12 is a floor candidate, not evidence of sufficient headroom.

The Visual Stimulus queue reached its 3-slot in-flight cap. Its 3312 observed capacity drops versus 2342 baseline, with only 287 admitted versus 1206 baseline, indicate substantial method/overhead or run variability. Repeat with controlled instrumentation before judging the 4-slot candidate.
Camera pending-record occupancy peaked at 14 of 10000 and had no capacity failure; do not increase it from these observations.
No test, video decode, hardware command, protocol mutation, or configuration change was performed for this assessment.
Tracking remains deferred. Eye camera is wired/paired by the owner request but was disabled in these trials. Photodiode assignment remains unset and physical optical timing remains deferred.
